why: The class the other five tasks were blind to. Every other task uses files small enough that reading all of them is the right move, so they cannot see whether addressing one part of a file helps. Here the file is 321 lines of forty near-identical functions and exactly one has to change: reading it whole costs about 4,800 prompt tokens, reading one symbol costs a few hundred. Measured before the hint existed, the model grepped twice, read all 321 lines, then edited. That number is what this task is here to move.
